{{Top}}
{{Youmay|armor in general|the [[Republic 68|comic]]}}
[[File:Stormclone-chart_negwt.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chart of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor]]
{{Quote|Before the Battle of Naboo, we wore blast armor as an indulgence. Now we consider it a necessity.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Armor''' was a protective covering worn mainly by militants. Some examples of armor are [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith battle suit|battle suits]], and light battle suits. Most armor would stop a standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt, although only advanced, heavy battle armor could withstand a heavy cannon bolt. Specialized weapons (called [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptors]]) could punch through armor. The term "armor" could also refer to the armored plating of a vehicle or [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

==Overview==
[[File:BountyHunterArmor-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Variations of bounty hunter armor used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]]]
Armor was generally divided into three classes: [[:Category:Light armor|light armor]], [[:Category:Medium armor|medium armor]], and [[:Category:Heavy armor|heavy armor]]. Light armor usually came in the form of woven cloth or thin plastics. Medium armor, by far the most common, was made up of small ceramic or metal plates. Heavy armor was designed for front-line combat, and is usually fully enclosed. [[:Category:Powersuits|Power armor]] is even heavier, fully enclosed armor; it's still debated if it's "mechanized heavy armor", or if it's entirely separate armor class. Many types of armor could work as, or be modified to have functions of, [[Environment_suit/Legends|Environment Suits]].

Most cultures and races used armor for forms of armed conflict. Some armor was implanted with [[Cortosis]] or other [[:Category:Lightsaber-resistant_materials|lightsaber-resistant materials]], and made especially for battle with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], though it also greatly increased protection from conventional weapons. Mandalorian armor was some of the best armor in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], notably the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] armor used during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

Usually, armor was much more restrictive than regular clothing. Most [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] did not use armor for this reason. Even though they did not wear armor, their robes had underlays for better protection. Though, armored Jedis weren't unheard of either - such as [[Anakin_Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wearing [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|heavy powersuit]]. Armor was also used to show either rank or what type of soldier the wearer was, such as in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

The [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] anti-infantry battery was enclosed by proton-shielded armor.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] warriors wore [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|Vonduun crab armor]], which had been created from bioengineering [[Vonduun crab/Legends|Vonduun crabs]] and was still alive.
